Hi Elena — thanks for the data, and cc Craig.

I reviewed the CSV and the latency traces with our runtime team this morning. High-level takeaways: 
- The token spike lines up with a new microservice rollout that switched from streaming to batched completion calls; prefix reuse is limited in that flow, so tokens per request jumped.
- We see a small regression (~60–90ms median) on your embedding endpoints tied to a recent quantization profile change for the model you pinned. We can roll back that profile or run an optimized kernel path.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min review meeting — I have availability Thursday 6/17 at 10:00 or Friday 6/18 at 14:00 PT.
2) Short-term mitigations: re-enable lighter quantization profile on embeddings, enable per-route KV prefix caching for the microservice, and add a 72-hour burst credit to smooth the spike while we finalize commit details.
3) Renewal options to present: 12-mo commit uplift (+20% tokens) with a reserved burst pool, or 18-mo stepped commit with a 10% lower unit price but incremental step-ups.

I'll prepare a one-pager and a proposal draft for the call. If either time works, I'll send a calendar invite and a pre-read.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
